human_name: Chromosome 14 short-arm rDNA + flanking segmental duplications

CHM13.note: T2T-CHM13 v2.0 chr14 p-arm — 0 to centromere boundary (~16.2 Mb). rDNA array core at 2,099,537-2,817,811 (~718 kb, smallest of the five). Coordinates from Nurk 2022, doi:10.1126/science.abj6987.

HPRC_pangenome_v1.1.note: HPRC v1.1 acrocentric pangenome — chr14 PHR total 6.48 Mb (largest of the five). Per Guarracino 2023.

copy_count_typical: ~17 rDNA copies on CHM13 hap (smallest array); SST1 array inverted at 14p11.2 vs chr13/21
architecture_note: GRCh38 chr14 p-arm is N-masked. SST1 array on 14p11.2 is in inverted orientation relative to chr13/chr21 (Guarracino 2023) — this orientation difference explains why chr14 involvement in Robertsonian translocations (most commonly 13;14 and 14;21) requires distinct mechanisms vs same-orientation chr13-chr21. chr14 PHR is the largest of the five at 6.48 Mb.

rDNA_array.copy_count_estimate: ~17 copies (CHM13 hap); smallest array of the five

sst1_array.note: Inverted orientation per Guarracino 2023 — distinguishes chr14 from same-orientation chr13/chr21 SD block

robertsonian_partners: chr13 (rob(13;14) is the most common Robertsonian translocation, ~1 in 1300 births)

primary.note: Same constraints as chr13 — multi-position by default. Orientation of SST1 (inverted vs chr13/21) can be a chr14-specific anchor when long-read context spans SST1 boundary.

fallback_chain.name: sst1_orientation_anchor
fallback_chain.rationale: inverted orientation distinguishes chr14 from chr13/chr21

fallback_chain.name: novel_haplotype_flag
fallback_chain.rationale: rob(13;14) and rob(14;21) products create chimeric p-arm chains

primary_sources.note: Nurk S et al., Science. T2T-CHM13 v2.0. rDNA array chr14 2099537-2817811 (718 kb, smallest of five).
Guarracino A et al., Nature. PHR chr14 = 6.48 Mb (largest PHR); SST1 inverted at 14p11.2 vs chr13/21.
Hoyt SJ et al., Science. Acrocentric repeat element characterisation.

supporting_databases: UCSC genomicSuperDups — does not cover chr14 p-arm (N-masked in hg38)
ClinGen Recurrent CNV list — Robertsonian rob(13;14), rob(14;21), rob(14;15), rob(14;22)
